name: Kensington Slimblade Trackball
notes: 75-byte report descriptor of the mouse interface of a real Kensington Slimblade Trackball, recorded with hid-recorder on Linux: https://github.com/jfedor2/hid-remapper/issues/2. The source gives the device's name, not its own USB strings, so productString is that name. Other interfaces of the real device are not part of this profile.
